author: source-content-author

scope.http: All retained production response bodies, statuses and exact response destinations were verified against the source-bound artifact evidence. Exact source artifacts or the two specifically approved complete provider insertions are required.
scope.pixels: All130 full-page captures were reviewed through13 contact sheets, followed by original-resolution representative home, hub, article, funeral-product, wedding-product and footer crops. Not every text string was reread at native resolution.
scope.navigation: Recorded native order controls, local navigation and source-bound canonical and robots checks were reviewed. External purchase completion was not tested.

limitations: Archived public captures apply to the exact source and execution revisions shown. Fresh full-artifact verification is required immediately before IndexNow.
Contact-sheet coverage is comprehensive; original-resolution close inspection is representative rather than a rereading of every text string.
Analytics requests were intentionally blocked during capture and analytics functionality was not verified.
No purchase, phone call, delivery or exhaustive accessibility test was performed. IndexNow receipt does not prove search indexing or ranking.
